hero.title: Building the web,
hero.description: I’m Hariprasath V, a full-stack developer shaping thoughtful digital products with considered interfaces and dependable engineering.

about.title: I like making complex things feel clear.
paragraphs: I’m a passionate Full Stack Developer, currently working as an intern at Sekel Tech in Pune. I build responsive web experiences with React.js, Next.js, Three.js, and Framer Motion.
My work spans the MERN stack and Spring Boot, with a focus on scalable applications that feel considered and work well across devices.
From interactive interfaces to backend services, I enjoy turning ideas into digital products that are both visually precise and useful.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: A couple of roles where I’ve built, learned, and contributed alongside teams.

points: Working as a Frontend Developer in a hyperlocal omni-channel platform using Next.js and API integration.
Building responsive, scalable UIs with smooth animations and enhanced user experiences.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver fast, interactive, and modern web solutions.
Worked on dynamic website development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
Developed backend services and RESTful APIs using PHP and XAMPP for smooth frontend integration.
Focused on responsive design, performance optimization, and application security across devices.
Performed unit testing, debugging, and code reviews to maintain high-quality code standards.

projects.title: Projects, made real.
projects.description: A selection of work across product interfaces, full-stack applications, and exploratory ideas. Each project links to its code and live version where available.

items.name: Medi-Vox – AI Medical Voice Assistant
items.description: A real-time AI medical voice agent that lets users speak naturally about health symptoms and receive instant, intelligent, context-aware medical guidance. Powered by AssemblyAI for STT/TTS, secured with Clerk authentication, and backed by Neon PostgreSQL with encrypted medical records.

items.name: Smart Retail Hub
items.description: An integrated system designed to optimize inventory management through automation and real-time monitoring. It combines automated checkout, sales tracking, and customer engagement for product tracking, predictive analytics, supply chain visibility, and better decision-making.

items.name: Budget Bloom
items.description: A full-stack app for managing finances by tracking income and expenses and analyzing spending with visual charts. It includes authentication, filters, financial insights, expense categorization, savings optimization, monthly reports, goal tracking, cash-flow analysis, and secure data storage.

items.name: Restaurant management system
items.description: A web-based management system designed to improve communication between clients and restaurant owners, including table reservations for dining.

items.name: GRADE CRAFT
items.description: A platform for educators and administrative staff addressing incident analysis and proactive safety management in educational institutions, with an emphasis on the complexities of aviation safety.

items.name: Fest-Book
items.description: An event management platform that connects organizers and customers, enabling event creation, promotion, and booking through a dynamic interface for interaction and communication.

items.name: AI-Smart HealthCare
items.description: A virtual doctor platform using AI to provide accessible healthcare remotely, especially in underserved areas. Built with React.js, Tailwind CSS, Clerk, and MongoDB to help bridge gaps in healthcare access.
